rows: If I am so little trouble, why are you spending so much time explaining me?
Brawling is a choice, and you chose it. Why?
A risk, you say. Let us see if you can still describe it once I have finished.
Slow questions. I like those. Let me ask you one.
The people came to see a fair contest. I intend to give them one, and I intend to be fair.
I would like a fair test, and I will know it when I have one.
You call me lucky. What exactly is it that you think I was lucky to get?
Look at the stance, and wait. Calm. You are looking for something in it. Take your time.
Technique. Say it slowly. What is the observable step that proves it? I will wait for the answer.
Strikes. Which ones? And how do you know they landed where you say?
A risk, a gamble, a choice. Whichever word you use, what does it cost you?
A stall. Interesting. Interesting. Who was it meant to fool?
The people want to see whether you have earned the spot. So do I.
You say I am unworthy. What is the test? Tell me, and I will take it.
Is your {strength} yours, or something you were told? Is it yours, or is it something you were told? Answer carefully.
I have been asking about your {strength}, and I keep getting the same answer. It is interesting that you keep giving it.
You are not hurrying. Interesting. Good. Now I wonder. A calm answer is still an answer, so give me one.
Fair, I wonder why. I wonder why. You have made a point, and I can see it. I will take it.
I could argue with that. A pause would do the job better.
One fall, to test. Simple enough to test. Keep me down, and tell me what you think you proved.
On the mat, every question I ask will have a pause after it. Watch what you do with the pause.
Grounded or standing, the question stays the same. Is it fair?
Stand up, and let me look. Let us see whether you can answer without being rushed.
That was an answer, eventually. It is a pity you took so long to give it.
Answer, when you are ready. I will wait a little longer.
Fair, I wonder why. I wonder why. That is one point I will keep.
I will concede that, slowly. We will test it at the bell, in order.
I will wrestle this match with careful questions, and I will let the result answer them.
My approach is patient. You will see the pause on the night.
Whatever happens, the observable record will speak for itself.
The question is not closed. There is a pause still to come.
I have one more question, and you will answer it when the bell rings.
